name: Past
overview: Scripture teaches that while the past includes both hardships and sins, believers are called to move forward, not dwelling on former things or looking back, as Jesus emphasized the necessity of focusing on the kingdom of God. God promises renewal and restoration from past troubles, and through repentance, past sins are forgiven, offering a fresh start without condemnation for those in Christ. This calls believers to forget the old and embrace the new life empowered by the Spirit.
